title: node.add_effect
description: Attach an effect node to a clip. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.5 node.add_effect. 'effect' is a node type id such as 'org.olivevideoeditor.Olive.blur' or an OFX identifier; OFX types are dynamic, so the id set is deliberately open - discover it with node.list_types.

effect.description: Node type id (built-in example ids: org.olivevideoeditor.Olive.blur, .saturation, .volume, .opacity, .gamma, .whitebalance, .chromakey, .sharpen, .noise, .crop, .dissolve) or an OFX identifier. Open set: not an enum, because OPP/1 section 8.5 exposes OFX types dynamically.

index.description: Insert position inside the clip's effect chain.
